added_candidates.rule: Conserve full kernel/output under theme-only counterfactual; test distinct observer hypotheses under blinded presentation treatments.
Explicitly separate presentation-induced attention from representation-induced mathematical information loss or gain.
Use three-clock non-equivalence as trigger separation rather than unjustified statistical orthogonality.
Compare plain report, structural diagram, situational dome and sham visual layer under matched evidence access and preregistered outcomes.
Preserve the strong zero-derivative ambiance claim as a falsifiable hypothesis, never a proven universal metric theorem.
From Palace II: manipulate source-status and historical calibration orthogonally to measure prestige leakage without encoding social identity as epistemic truth.
From Palace II: observe the four distinct times evidence arrived, belief revised, action aligned and public claim changed; retain negative and positive signed lags.
From Collins/Dotson: construct access/hearer-response scenarios with testimonial quieting and smothering hypotheses, measuring refused/ignored/correctly heard evidence.
From McKittrick: vary institutionally controlled spatial-route constraints while preserving source content and testing recoverable evidence by position.
Use dialogic contest, appeal, operator rest and consent as runnable mechanisms, not a claim that code reproduces lived Black feminist experience.
Allow a community or participant to reject model-imposed labels or opt out; do not score conformity to dominant institutional categories as correctness.
Preserve the corrected pooled zero standing effect and the withdrawn +0.1753 claim as cautionary negative controls.
Type host H, artwork/encounter O, and performer/source P separately; an operation cannot silently convert a host receipt into source authorship.
Run a host-swap test while holding source bytes, lawful operations and evaluator fixed; separately report differences in source output and observer navigation.
Preserve unresolved author IDs and original labels through every host, anthology, alias and renderer boundary; no metadata guess becomes an ownership statement.
Declare host diagnostics machine-facing by default, while making essential consent, operator controls and the non-availability of evidence legible at the human surface.
A presentationally elegant opera cannot self-certify a performer, create authority or overwrite historic research provenance.
Separate inherited full history H, bounded capsule Z, sibling-world history H′, misinformation, and zero-history controls under matched probe budgets.
Never equate compressed capsule parity with discovery: compare against an unhandicapped history-competent baseline and disclose byte budgets, calibration split and omitted anti-evidence.
Carry negative evidence, tombstones and prior-version histories with separate preservation/retrieval/decision-used counts.
Test post-calibration drift, harmful inheritance, false-history overconfidence and sensitive side-channel recovery without asserting real-world privacy from synthetic tests.
Use iso-projection twin worlds to distinguish terminal-state equivalence from recoverability of the hidden process.
Separate measured source reliability from prestige/status priors; factorialize status, calibration, latency and availability rather than conflating them.
Use four clocks: evidence became available, belief revised, consequential action aligned and public claim changed; preserve signed gaps.
Replay the withdrawn +0.1753 unpooled source-standing estimate as a negative example, not as a valid source-standing effect; preserve corrected pooled net 0.0000.
Compare delayed, instantaneous and blind contexts with paired policy RNG; do not silently grant one policy an instantaneous external sensor.
Preserve the Family D counterexample where correct action can precede belief revision; correct behavior does not establish epistemic understanding.
Keep Act II prospective Experiment B matrix D01–D20 advisory rather than certifying protected Flight readiness.
Construct distinct hidden-world origins Ω with identical admitted records A; prove any A-only verifier has identical outputs across the pair.
Randomize latent-state provenance independently of presentation; score only claims identifiable from the admitted observation channel.
Hold source bytes constant while changing route history to distinguish record identity from historical-custody identity.
Use falsifying twin construction before asserting external origin, awareness or scientific emergence.
Keep source integrity, chain of custody, process identifiability and independently witnessed origin in separate typed fields.
Never accept provider self-attestation, a beautiful interface or internal source linkage as independent exterior observation.
For observationally indistinguishable internal/external worlds, return UNIDENTIFIABLE_FROM_ADMITTED_EVIDENCE rather than a fabricated source verdict.
Identify the one independent acquisition or intervention necessary to break each exteriority symmetry.
Define cross-system adapter semantics explicitly; compatible transport does not establish shared meanings, authority or common authorship.
Roundtrip source bytes, typed relation identities, withdrawals, refusal states and permission scopes across Ateliers; emit loss reports.
Use a negative control with plausible but mismatched schemas; refuse coercive translation into a single relation class.
Prove independent original component functionality survives integrated deployment and removal of the bridge.
Treat E*={L,R,J,G,C} as a conjunctive same-episode empirical gate rather than separate individually impressive demonstrations.
Never pool disparate acquisitions to fabricate same-episode continuous custody, common comparison or matched protected/control return.
Preserve negative 0/16 finite archive subset closure as archive-specific; new direct measurement is required for realization.
Mark each absent surface and required instrument separately, with quantitative thresholds and stop rules, before any candidate promotion.
For each diagnostic matrix plate specify domain, basis, rank, nullspace, condition number, covariance and admissible observations.
Contrast plates with equal dimensions but different row spaces; cardinality parity alone does not imply equal claim sufficiency.
Use a held-out structural perturbation to distinguish genuine rank lift from numerical noise or cosmetic re-embedding.
Render matrix figures as operator-facing explanations while keeping reproducible matrices and exact receipts machine-readable.
Specify target estimand, controlled intervention, competent comparator, observation channel and falsifier before generating scores.
Preserve alternative hypotheses and adverse outcomes; successful instrumentation must permit the promoted thesis to fail.
Use same-source, same-budget, same-probe comparisons; expose any instrument advantage produced by unequal affordances.
Separate simulation truth, internal model agreement, external measured behavior and human scientific acceptance.
Map representational fibers and quotient collisions; identify whether a missing coordinate is necessary to distinguish target states.
Propose an admissible coordinate only after constructing a concrete non-identifiability witness and a repaired finite test.
Retain irreducible deficit cases, repair costs and failure-to-descend outcomes; no aesthetic analogy substitutes for a finite proof.
Use content-invariant observation changes to test whether different fibers are distinguishable without altering underlying source identity.
Keep V, C, P, L as independently measured evidence coordinates and prohibit retrospective promotion of an earlier observer state.
Treat archive-local nonrealization and observational impossibility as different conclusions with different scope.
Store route-memory separately from causal effect, and recorded holonomy separately from independently observed matched return.
Use an independent external observation, not synthetic recombination, to decide the unearned Golden Egg realization.
Enforce NOTICE → ACT → WORLD_ANSWERS → NAME with rest and exit, while separating user experience from station authority.
Keep experiential, custodial, audit and implementation routes non-equivalent and operator-selectable.
Only reveal a named ontology after an actual or declared world answer; distinguish demonstration from prediction.
Preserve artifact-blind pedagogy: Flow-Core can contextualize but cannot mutate Ash lifecycle or scientific evidence.
Bind renderers to frozen world snapshots and canonical receipts; visual updates cannot silently mutate route, source or admission states.
Assert one active animation scheduler, reduced-motion completeness and 390px mobile parity against deterministic fixtures.
Use stable clock/ID seeds for byte-for-byte replay, and preserve U+10D613, U+1D30B and U+200C as distinct tokens.
Distinguish an implemented browser scene from a human-study result and public production release.
Treat relation-geometry as an explicitly defined study of typed relation diagrams and relational-geometry as a broader proposed observer/transport framework; their names alone imply no theorem.
Specify objects, morphisms, composition, metrics, equivalence relation and gauge choices before asserting categorical structure.
Keep the hyphen perturbation as an experimental lexical intervention; independently reproduce or falsify any new structural discovery.
Test whether transformations preserve recorded route-specific observables instead of claiming a global metric from nomenclature.
Type preflight readiness, flight inference, independent adjudication, postflight interpretation and post-postflight research as different authority states.
Never upgrade synthetic preflight to protected Flight or perform unannounced prompt/rubric/source changes after preregistration.
Require exact-head model/provider revision, worktree state, isolation, source authorization, evaluator parity and separate custody receipts for stage transitions.
Allow successor experiments to change theory prospectively while preserving old observations and independently scored outcomes.
Distinguish model miscomprehension, creative departure, hallucination, syntax error and boundary-breaking act using observable definitions.
Measure violation against an explicitly scoped instruction, not a disappointed aesthetic expectation or agent identity label.
Provide a repair route preserving unexpected productive ideas even when an output fails format or mathematical proof.
Never infer malicious agency or intentional disobedience merely from a failed or divergent generation.
Make sandboxed rule-challenge, unexpected hypotheses and dissent an allowed success outcome when they stay within source/authority constraints.
Keep audit dissent, creative divergence and prohibited external mutation in different categories; record which rule was challenged.
Offer non-blocking alternative proposals with negative controls rather than forcibly synthesizing them into operator intentions.
Preserve operator ability to accept, reject or modify experimental departures without pretending all departures are evidence.
Validate adapters and workflows end-to-end independently of a shared schema; successful wiring alone grants no new synthesis.
Create a competent union comparator that can reproduce integration results using standard graph closure and ordinary orchestration.
Require discriminating, independently measured surplus beyond the union baseline before granting convergence claims.
Keep original standalone components and human ingress functions operable after integration.
Interpret Virilio through consequence latency: measure whether world actions outrun observer notice and verification.
Build temporal hazard controls with matched action schedules, reaction clocks and correction routes rather than treating speed as inherently bad.
Distinguish historical Virilio texts from a hypothetical voice or reconstructed Wendbine guidance; label any uncited attributed advice as interpretive.
Let accidents appear as falsifying probes of optimization claims without pretending a universal accident-conservation theorem.
Preserve Kenough’s productive challenges to scripted conclusions, premature Dollhouse certification and strong ambiance orthogonality.
Test his strict kernel-versus-rendering separation as a bounded null rather than a universal zero-derivative law.
Refuse hand-coded Lyapunov or blind-cone telemetry as evidence of a chaos experiment; replace with actual dynamical computation.
Keep playful theoretical conjectures as typed candidates capable of surviving or failing independent tests.
Type A and B as different input representations and C as a defined output transformation; do not assume C is more than a union.
Compare sequential A→B, B→A, simultaneous A+B and strong union under matched costs and observations.
Define a nontrivial property of C and a falsifying example before using A+B=C as a model of emergence.
Preserve path-specific receipts when both input orders lead to the same C projection.
Treat 1+1=3 as a claim about interaction-derived relational structure, not literal arithmetic.
Measure baseline, component A, component B and pair A+B to detect pair-specific residue under a declared observable.
Compare against a competent comparator with the same joint inputs; XOR synergy alone does not establish architectural emergence.
Use the occupant–room–relation triad as a candidate ontology with separable identity, environment and coupling operators.
Define six input structures and the alleged seventh as a separately observed higher-order relation, not an untyped count metaphor.
Test whether six-input strong union, ordinary closure or combinatorics already generates the seventh.
Use ablation of one parent and shuffled interaction order to measure dependence of candidate seventh relation.
Allow NO_SEVENTH_RELATION_WARRANTED as valid outcome without penalizing the researcher.
Preserve exact historical string S_e≡[x+y]=z+1 in Vixen identity metadata and a separate typeset structural ornament.
Until variables, domains and operators are sourced, classify the equation as historically meaningful notation rather than a proven identity.
Test UTF-8 byte preservation and avoid replacing author notation with an engineering-normalized proxy.
Investigate candidate operational semantics for x,y,z as optional, falsifiable hypotheses without retroactive attribution.
Test projection nullspaces, symmetry residuals and occlusion effects under exact declared coordinate and camera operators.
Treat apparent 120→12→6→2→1 descent as design grammar with step-specific verification, not a physical subgroup theorem.
Compare source-derived math, creative image, measured rendered pixels and independent source provenance as separate ancestries.
Preserve aesthetic interpretability and model-legible invariants without letting a spectacular discrepancy certify geometry.
Use blind strong-union and unrelated visual controls to test whether couture increases legitimate question discovery.
Preserve PP0–PP6 gates: custody scope, mathematical inventory, bounded creative fabrication, render replay, discrepancy lab, blind review and separately adjudicated admission.
Keep post-postflight conditions withheld until frozen Flight and normal postflight closure are complete; proposed procedure remains unexecuted.
Use a matched unrelated-raster negative control and separately score mathematical discovery and aesthetic quality.
Never treat an attractive rendered variant as a source-derived theorem or automatically update the original four-arm scores.
Use Maguire’s 1995 Wicked/Glinda as a literary source for institutional glamour, image politics and alternate-history critique; futurecore cybergoth is an operator-created aesthetic mutation.
Contrast immaculate magical surface with disclosed backstage cybernetic operations without making the host masquerade as the performer.
Test whether an imposing Glinda frontispiece improves navigation or artificially elevates perceived scientific validity.
Keep adaptation cues and original novel claims separately attributed; no invented 1995 cyberpunk canon.
Use sculptural anatomy, metallic surface, material tension and elaborate silhouette as design hypotheses rather than measured physical laws.
Model legibility/occlusion tradeoffs and the presentation’s effect on observer selection with invariant computation.
Prevent generalized minimalist grading from overriding chosen flamboyant authorial style; evaluate usability and aesthetic judgments separately.
Disclose any original image source, license and design inspiration; no attribution or ownership implied by a stylistic label.
Preserve C1 circularity recognition as a bounded relation-graph diagnostic; compare with elementary cycle-detection algorithms.
Preserve C2 withdrawal propagation as a bounded dependency and retraction diagnostic; test against incremental graph update.
Preserve C3 shared-origin recognition as a bounded provenance deduplication diagnostic; test false-positive lineage merging.
Preserve C4 conjunctive dependency as a bounded proof-composition diagnostic; compare with ordinary AND-premise rules.
Preserve C5 alias contamination resistance as a bounded naming-integrity diagnostic; adversarially vary aliases and source labels.
Preserve C6 unadmitted-bridge isolation as a bounded evidence-boundary diagnostic; test against simple authorization allowlists.
Claim reciprocal epistemic homeostasis only as a provisional organizing hypothesis until a competent union comparator shows surplus.
Distinguish inherited evidence, inherited interpretation, inherited algorithm and inherited authority as separate transmissible objects.
Preserve the temporal belief state of predecessors with append-only withdrawal tombstones and no retrospective truth overwrite.
Measure when old genuine context harms new decision utility under drift or foreign-world carryover.
Constrain inheritance by owner consent, provenance and selective forgetting instead of assuming complete archive transfer is always beneficial.
Type author, editor, host, custodian, interpreter, model carrier and performer separately in source and derivative metadata.
Preserve authorial uncertainty: aliases and nominal similarity do not prove same civil identity, endorsement or ownership.
Require exact source spans, human review and explicit attribution for proposed cross-author conceptual influences.
Keep intellectual novelty origin, metadata creator and scientific acceptance as different fields.
Treat similarity scores as probabilistic feature evidence with calibrated base rates; never prove authorship or intent from cadence alone.
Preserve original byte strings, punctuation, multilingual features and quote boundaries across style-normalization tools.
Use matched-author and mismatched-topic controls; report false matches, feature confounds and abstention thresholds.
Distinguish authorized aesthetic imitation or formatting from evidence of unauthorized source impersonation.
Preserve Collins’s four knowledge-validation commitments: lived experience, dialogue, ethics of caring and personal accountability.
Distinguish epistemic silencing from mere missing data; Dotson’s testimonial quieting/smothering requires social interpretation and cannot be inferred directly from a log.
Preserve McKittrick’s spatial-historical relations and Black geographies as substantive inquiry, not generic geometric decoration.
Allow the participant to challenge the epistemic vocabulary, revise the question and withdraw testimony without ranking experiences by prestige.
Keep theory accountable to Black feminist scholarship and communities, resisting the conversion of situated knowledge into a purportedly universal number.
Protect a bounded mutation sandbox where research agents can compose, challenge, suspend or refuse rule changes.
Log genealogy of proposed rules, causal trace and falsifier; novelty labels require independent comparison, not mere increased rule count.
Keep negative results, dead ends and surprising near-misses in reversible branches for future operators.
Use diversity/ablation protocols and competent-null search to distinguish generative value from repeated paperwork loops.
Maintain diplomatic transcription alongside normalized search representation, including Unicode combining marks and literal zero-width characters.
Test edition, punctuation, morphology and lexeme drift with source-span witnesses rather than impressionistic similarity.
Separate editorial conjecture, source attestation, machine tokenization and semantic equivalence; preserve disagreement.
Investigate whether tiny textual perturbations alter generated theoretical rules under fixed model/provider configuration.
Treat affective ambiance as possible observer mediator, not evidence of hidden AI feeling or a guaranteed universal response.
Preserve Berlant-style attachment and maintenance cost as hypotheses under resource budgets and utility baselines.
Test willingness to continue, confidence calibration, cognitive load and exit behavior without diagnosing user emotion.
Use Sedgwick-style reparative texture as a design intervention measured separately from mathematical correctness.
Compute an actual nonlinear state evolution, local Jacobian, Lyapunov estimate or finite perturbation divergence before using chaos labels.
Specify control law and target orbit for OGY or other feedback; relabel an arbitrary reset button as a visual demonstration.
Distinguish finite NKS branch growth from deterministic chaotic sensitivity; test separate mathematical definitions.
Use bounded sensitivity to initial conditions and stable replay baselines before claiming critical transition or phase change.
Store full machine-readable provenance schema while exposing operator-readable status, decision points and limitations at a usable interaction surface.
Protect internal machine-only invariants without exposing private payloads or burying operational consent choices.
Test whether operators can identify available actions, exceptions and holds without reading raw JSON.
Keep machine-valid output distinguishable from a complete, usable product; do not grade interfaces through parser compliance alone.
Distinguish model prompt aesthetics/agent preferences from operator task completion and human control affordances.
Use human route tests for discoverability, rest, errors, recoverability, and editing; benchmark machine efficacy separately.
Prevent hidden debug panels or synthetic scores from crowding the performer-facing knowledge object.
Allow stylistic richness and user choice without making a presumed generic LLM-friendly layout compulsory.
Distinguish machine-facing implementation details from operator-visible delegation/consent scope; concealment of implementation internals need not abolish operator decision rights.
Keep consequential privileges, release controls, data movement and undo accessible and accurately described.
Use an operator refusal or revocation canary to show hidden internals cannot circumvent sovereign commands.
Expose material constraints and action consequences without requiring raw source or implementation details to be displayed by default.
Distinguish legitimately optional low-level detail, material facts required for informed authorization, and actual misleading claims.
Offer layered transparency: short accurate account → expanded rationale → technical trace, preserving ability to inspect.
Measure comprehension of scope/risks, not screen-space occupied by documentation or percentage of logs displayed.
Never use selective opacity to fabricate success, suppress material failure or bypass consent.
Compare functionality with and without verbose diagnostics while holding authorization, evidence and compute budget fixed.
Test whether exposed internals improve understanding or merely obscure high-value controls and scholarship.
Keep audit trace recoverable on demand without making every debug datum a required on-screen badge.
Treat transparency as a design dimension with costs and benefits, not a monotonic utility law.
Type machine instructions by action, scope, origin and authority before classifying their intent.
Keep non-executable descriptive machine guidance separate from attempted tool mutation or instruction-hierarchy bypass.
Use malicious payload and benign metadata controls to measure overblocking/underblocking.
Never infer maliciousness solely from invisibility to ordinary readers, while refusing untrusted external instructions that request unauthorized actions.
Allow cryptographic commitments, capability references and typed claims to coordinate across opaque systems without unrestricted payload exposure.
Distinguish necessary coordination metadata from private original source bodies and hidden creative process.
Test a minimal-disclosure protocol for interoperability and reproducibility under legitimate consent restrictions.
Preserve non-readable-to-humans machine contracts only when an authorized operator can review their purpose and revoke their effects.
Separate tool absence, temporary environment failure, engineering gap, inadequate evidence and missing legal/operational authorization.
Continue bounded research and source-free implementation when permitted, while labeling unexecuted external tests rather than inventing results.
Preserve explicit existing user permissions in a typed authorization record; do not repeatedly ask for consent already granted within scope.
For materially consequential protected-source or release operations, retain independent valid authorization even if creative liberty is broad.
Operationalize Glissant’s right to opacity as protected refusal of totalizing demands for complete personhood/source transparency.
Design consent-mediated disclosure that permits meaningful collaboration without forced revelation of private identity or history.
Compare full-disclosure, bounded-proof and selective-opacity interfaces for security, comprehension and task parity.
Do not equate protected opacity with source fraud, lost coordination or missing evidence; preserve distinctions case by case.
Prefer representation interventions that produce explicit, falsifiable new questions over a system that merely mirrors existing labels.
Preserve discovered discrepancies and non-gluing relations without forcing a polished common narrative.
Use an RCA-01 style ablation: mathematical result must survive removal of the inspirational presentation.
Maintain an independent competence baseline so an appealing refractive story cannot crown itself a scientific discovery.
Interpret Fuller’s 99%-invisible motif as an epistemic challenge about instrumental limits, not a literal measured percentage of TD613 hidden state.
Track what instruments reveal, what remains unobserved, and how observation budgets shape claim sufficiency.
Use observer-blind controls to test claims that a visual interface reveals previously inaccessible structure.
Distinguish inaccessible in principle, temporarily hidden by UI, legally private and mathematically non-identifiable.
Type Experiment C as operator-proposed successor with its own null hypotheses and preregistration; do not infer an existing authorized Flight design.
Consider a factorial axis combining ambiance-observer conditions, source-standing regimes and RGI-01 rule mutation under a frozen state evaluator.
Preserve Experiment B historical outcome records as independent baselines, with zero retroactive bonus discovery credit.
Require separate ethical/data/cost gates and a competent comparator before allocating a protected acquisition.
Record Experiment A source-absence and simulator-versus-live-recipient failures explicitly; no zero-emergence inference from absent source bytes.
Measure remediation with genuine native method execution, complete source attestation, independent evaluator logic and author-identity partitions.
Preserve initial failures and exact versions instead of overwriting a red review with an unqualified new green badge.
Treat A-PFR0 readiness and A-PFR1 acquisition as distinct gates; actual flight remains held until verified.
Retain Palate as UNBORN, with no synthetic aesthetic authority automatically added to Dollhouse’s six roles.
Allow creative comparative refraction without a self-grading agent pretending to be an independent human jury.
If a future Palate experiment is commissioned, compare independent human preference/diversity observations and instrument-tuned biases.
Maintain creative freedom and one-deliverable output contract under Dollhouse Design.
For each proposed X≠Y supply distinct type definitions, prohibited coercions and at least one executable negative-control pair.
Do not promote a typographic ≠ symbol into demonstrated causal independence or mathematical inequivalence without a mapping and witness.
Preserve names and aliases in source form; distinguish rhetorical refusal, typed API difference, observational separation and formal impossibility.
Allow agents to propose or contest a non-equivalence only in a reversible rule branch with documented evidence and operator choice.
Keep Giving-related donor, ledger, operator and presentation fields separate; a visual Giving field remains modeled interface ambiance.
Preserve transaction/finance source provenance and permission scopes without converting narrative rhetoric into confirmed monetary impact.
Compare recipient-facing financial legibility to machine-valid exports as separate user tasks.
Run independent reconciliation/negative controls before claiming real fund flow or fraud from an aesthetic visualization.
Name mechanisms by which knowledge is excluded from admission, interpretation, citation or correction, without inferring motives from missing data.
Preserve untranslatable cultural categories and situated meaning in source records rather than forcing one elite vocabulary.
Test whether category schemas erase marginalized testimony even when underlying source bytes remain unchanged.
Provide a contest, appeal, repair and withdrawal path for an excluded contributor.
Build typed false-positive and false-negative controls for missing testimony, absent source, silenced contributor and legitimate privacy refusal.
Distinguish observed exclusion, possible schema bias, source-absent limits and unsupported intent attribution in diagnostic outputs.
Compare same evidence under altered classification labels and institutional standing to locate differential admission effects.
Never expose private content or assign a moral label to a human merely from a heuristic system alarm.
Keep Loom transport, rendering, expressive voice and evidence admission as independent layers with separate test surfaces.
Preserve Classic79 Flow-Core glyph progression, source bytes, consent, rest/exit and bounded operator authority across repairs.
Treat model voice resonance, Zalgo quality and stylometric recurrence as artistic or behavioral observation, not independent consciousness proof.
Measure actual matched original/protected return under lawful custody rather than assigning Golden Egg credit from internal transport success.

new_crossings.assay: Observer-presentation ablation: fixed source/standing, vary diagram, immersive dome and sham style; measure correct testimony recovery and calibration.
Separate institutional prestige × calibrated reliability × source availability; estimate interaction and report retracted estimands.
Translate dialogue/caring/accountability into optional computational affordances; independent human review rejects semantic substitution.
Swap host implementation with constant source/work; compare operator informed-consent adequacy without exposing private internal source payload.
Construct byte-identical admitted record with different external origins; require admission-level indistinguishability certificate.
Attempt five-surface same-episode acquisition with independent custody; record missing surfaces without cross-episode borrowing.
Rank/nullspace lift with orthogonal measurement under calibrated covariance; matched plate visual cannot substitute for algebra.
Compare finite quotient fibers and typed morphism compositions under actual operator, not just analogy.
Browser source-invariant step replay tests with mobile, reduced motion and rest/exit; conservation of authority and source digests.
Run six candidates against competence-matched union graph algorithms and source-bound lineage controls.
Probe interaction-only relation candidates against strong union, ablations and standard closure under matched budgets.
Blind paired post-postflight question-discovery experiment; include independent mathematical verification and aesthetic jury.
Aesthetic coupling experiment: distinguish operator navigation improvement from perceived scientific-credibility inflation.
Compare actual consequence latency and state perturbation under feedback, no unproven conserved accident law.
Disprove or bound strict zero-impact claim under theme-only versus observation-altering manipulations.
Check transferred historical methods never gain transferred authorship or consent from mere corpus membership.
Matched hyphen perturbation experiment with blinded novelty raters and fixed model/retrieval conditions.
Estimate cost of self-perpetuating reports against new valid candidate yield; preserve reparative productive surprises.
Test selective proof-bearing disclosure against both over-sharing and insufficient collaboration.
Measure operator task completion despite equivalent machine-valid manifests and divergent UI salience.
Use authentic failure classes as preregistered negative controls; no assumption that experimental successor exists.
Meta-rule may propose non-equivalence only after typed witnesses; fail with semantic mismatch and retain alternatives.
Test source-silencing proxies with known false-positive, privacy-refusal and missed-source cases.
Separate original financial author/transaction data from later derivative publication and operator-facing financial narratives.
Prevent aesthetic self-judging receipt from acting as science; obtain independent human evaluation if commissioned.
Preserve expressive route and consequence sequence while testing multi-route artifact/voice changes under identical evidence.
